title: Late Fee Level by Account History — Ridgeline Consumer Credit Fee Table
content:
**Fee level.** The fee level is the amount a Ridgeline Consumer Credit late fee starts from. It rests on the account's own history, each count covering the account's own ledger lines dated less than the stated number of full months before today:

| Account history | Fee level |
|---|---|
| a late fee was charged, or a payment was returned unpaid, on the account in the last 6 months | the tier's repeat late fee |
| no late fee was charged in the last 24 months, no payment was returned unpaid in the last 6 months, and the account has been open 60 full months or more | 25.00 |
| otherwise | the tier's first late fee |

The tier's repeat and first late fees are those of the Ridgeline Consumer Credit fee schedule (on the card tiers 43.00 and 32.00; on the Project Loan tiers 39.00 and 39.00).

## Combinations (hypothetical card account; repeat 43.00, first 32.00)

| Late fee in last 6 months | Returned payment in last 6 months | Late fee in last 24 months | Full months open | Fee level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | yes | any | 43.00 |
| no | yes | any | any | 43.00 |
| no | no | no | 72 | 25.00 |
| no | no | no | 59 | 32.00 |
| no | no | yes (10 months ago) | 72 | 32.00 |

## Boundaries

- A late fee dated exactly 6 full months before today is outside the 6-month count; one dated a day later is inside.
- An account opened on 10 March 2021 has 59 full months on 9 March 2026 and 60 on 10 March 2026.
